opportunities.title: Research Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications will not be considered. Early career researchers are welcome.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, with no period, geographic or disciplinary restrictions across archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture, and the history of collecting. Named sub-awards include the Marion Wilson, Joan Pye and Hugh Chapman Memorial Awards.

opportunities.title: Hugh Phillips Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards will not be made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree. Retrospective applications will not be considered.
opportunities.summary: A named research fund within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme supporting research into the human past, focused on Britain pre-1800.

opportunities.title: Margaret and Tom Jones Memorial Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Two references are required.
opportunities.summary: A named research fund within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme supporting research into the material past.

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references are required. Applications made via the Grants Application Portal with supporting documents such as photographs, architect/conservation reports or budgets.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of churches, with two application rounds each year (31 March and 31 August).

opportunities.title: Linda Parry Textile Conservation and Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references are required. Applications are made via the Grants Application Portal selecting the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants form.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting textile conservation and research. Applications are submitted via the William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants form.
